note: Paths are resolved by src/rffi_calibration/registry.py (environment variables of the same name override). Nothing here authorises numeric access: see roles.json + registration.json reservation.

wisig.description: WiSig ManyRx (Kaggle v1 repack of the official release), WiFi, unequalised 256-sample IQ
wisig.archive_sha_status: local SHA matches the 2026-10-13 acquisition record; official byte equivalence unproven
wisig.cache_note: 72 files = 24 non-final RX x dates {0,1,2}; final-8 RX and date 3 were never cached
wisig.label_map: task label = cache y (TX index 0..9 in registration wisig.tx_names order)
wisig.historical_8_class_note: train_wisig_p2.py / W0 used TX 0-7 only; 8-class results are historical-compatibility only
wisig.sample_unit_note: position = index inside the (RX, date) cell of the cache, not a timestamp; packets are separately detected by WiSig but their capture time is not in the cache

shen.description: Shen et al. receiver-agnostic LoRa dataset, Strict CIS front end (G1)
shen.cache_note: only the 10 source RX are cached (2000 rows = 200 per TX); development / reserved RX are not
shen.label_map: raw labels 31..40 -> task labels 0..9 (cache labels.npy already mapped)
shen.scaler: global mean/std over fitting packets only (receiver_r01.data.shen, stored with each checkpoint)
shen.sample_unit_note: rows.npy = original HDF5 row; row order is NOT verified to be time order and the root files carry no verified session/date

osu.description: OSU LoRa Diff_Receivers_Setup_Indoor_SameTx: 25 LoPy4 TX, 2 USRP B210 RX, one continuous capture per (TX, RX)
osu.label_map: Device{k} -> task label k-1; OSU labels are NOT Shen labels
osu.sample_unit_note: 8192-sample analysis windows on a fixed grid, selected by periodic-phase coherence (G1 build_osu); no packet detector, windows are not packets
osu.front_end: G1 Strict CIS (src/shen_p2a8/g1_data.py build_osu + save_features); compatibility with Shen front end asserted only for window length 8192 at 1 MS/s
